removeBackground.name: removeBackground
removeBackground.description: Remove the background of the image given as input

aiMetadata.description: Removes the background from an input image using the Photoroom segmentation API and writes the cutout to a file. Choose this to isolate a subject or produce a transparent-background version of a photo. Requires the raw image as a file input plus a filename for the generated output; the call is a pure transformation, so repeating it on the same image yields the same result with no extra side effect.
